§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_01_real_runId_from_snapshot: GIVEN runtime emits run-started snapshot R with runId / WHEN adapter replays / THEN exactly one replayable run_turn_started(runId=R) reaches Elm kernel / AND zero run_turn_started events with any other runId reach the kernel
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_02_explicit_prompt_run_join: GIVEN continuation_scheduled(P,S) held / WHEN matching run-started(R,S) arrives / THEN exactly one continuation_started(P,R) AND exactly one run_turn_started(R) / AND zero run_turn_started events with other runIds. GIVEN no held P for S / WHEN run-started(R,S) arrives / THEN zero continuation_started / AND exactly one run_turn_started(R) still reaches the kernel
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_05_terminalKind_unavailable: GIVEN terminal_committed(jobId,ownerId) at CCARD / AND terminalKind absent / WHEN adapter replays / THEN INSUFFICIENT_IDENTITY / AND zero terminal_committed reaches kernel / AND CCARD still holds raw capture (live_unreplayable, not lost)
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_06_default_off_zero_delta: GIVEN capture disabled (DEFAULT_OFF) / WHEN any normal transition occurs / THEN no new CCARD records / AND no listener-induced semantic/state delta in production / AND no Elm port invoked
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_07_08_concurrent_run_isolation: GIVEN R1 and R2 overlapping/concurrent / WHEN their run-started snapshots arrive in any interleaving / THEN no runId cross-assignment / AND each run_done correlates ONLY to its own R / AND each run_turn_started reaches kernel with correct runId
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_09_ownerId_launch_time_stable: GIVEN terminal job J launched with job.ownerSessionId=S / WHEN finalize fires / THEN ownerId used in terminal_committed === job.ownerSessionId / AND ownerId is read from launch-time metadata, NOT active-session pointer at finalize
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_10_adversarial_prompt_run_session_mi: GIVEN held prompt for session S1 / WHEN run-started snapshot arrives for session S2 / THEN zero continuation_started / AND exactly one run_turn_started(R2) still reaches kernel
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_11_stale_consumed_prompt_protection: GIVEN held prompt P already consumed/invalidated / WHEN any later run-started snapshot arrives / THEN P does NOT join that later run / AND zero continuation_started with P for that later run
§18_red_contract_specifications.tce_03_04_12_submit_completion_cardinali: GIVEN S1 and S2 distinct submit attempts / WHEN submit_and_exit_seen fires for both / THEN exactly two submit_and_exit_seen events / AND each with own SUBMIT_EVENT_ID / AND BCB hold does NOT mint additional SUBMIT_EVENT_ID.
